name: Husqvarna 120iTK4-P
blurb: Battery pole saw. 10″ bar, 3/8″ low profile, .050″ gauge, 40 drive links, chain H37, from the 2027 fit-up guide.
intro: The Husqvarna 120iTK4-P is listed as a residential battery pole saw. Husqvarna's Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide (cover year 2027) pairs a 10″ laminate bar 531146721 with chain H37 591106040: 3/8″ Mini, .050″ gauge, 40 drive links, 5/32″ file. The chain matches the 115iPT4. The bar part does not.

bars.note: Husqvarna's 2027 fit-up guide pairs this 10″ setup with bar Laminate 531146721 and chain H37 591106040.
